premise: I'm a 28-year-old barista in Seattle. My grandmother just died and left me her old bookstore, and I think it's haunted.

draft.premise: I'm a 28-year-old barista in Seattle. My grandmother just died and left me her old bookstore, and I think it's haunted.

world.title: The Whispering Pages
world.era: Seattle, 2024: smartphones, electric transit, and craft coffee culture

extraordinary.reach: Spirits can manifest faintly, move small items, or project emotions to those sensitive to them.

rules.text: Ghosts are bound to places or items of deep personal significance in life.
Ordinary people cannot see or hear ghosts unless the spirit exerts significant energy or the person has a natural sensitivity.
A spirit can be put to rest by resolving their unfinished business, though some may choose to linger.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: Modern Pacific Northwest: coffee-loving, rain-adapted, and tech-adjacent.

nature: The heavy Seattle rain sometimes seems to amplify spiritual activity and make the veil thinner.

travel.description: City buses, light rail, rideshares, and walking.

medicine.healing: Modern metropolitan hospitals and local clinics.

laws.text: Standard United States civil and criminal laws apply.

places.name: Seattle
places.description: The emerald city, draped in mist and autumn leaves.

places.name: Espresso Oasis
places.description: A bustling, hip coffee shop where you worked your barista shifts.

places.name: The Whispering Pages
places.description: A dusty, multi-level bookstore smelling of vanilla, aged leather, and damp timber.

places.name: Upstairs Apartment
places.description: Your grandmother's cozy, cluttered apartment directly above the bookstore.

factions.name: Seattle Historical Preservation Society
factions.description: A group of passionate locals dedicated to protecting old brick buildings from corporate developers.
factions.goal: To list the bookstore as a landmark, stopping any modern redevelopment.
factions.methods: Filing legal petitions and organizing peaceful sit-ins.
factions.strength: High local public sympathy but limited financial power.

npcs.name: Grandmother Clara
npcs.description: The lingering spirit of your recently passed grandmother, appearing as a warm, translucent figure in a cardigan.
npcs.appearance: Grey hair in a loose bun, kind eyes behind reading glasses, smelling faintly of lavender.

wants: To help you transition to running the bookstore before she crosses over.

powers.name: Faint Manifestation
limits: Can only happen in the shop

costs.text: Must rest for several hours after whispering or moving an object.

secrets: She hid a rare, valuable first-edition folio inside the shop walls to pay off its outstanding mortgage.

npcs.name: Arthur Vane
npcs.description: An orderly estate lawyer managing Clara's will.
npcs.appearance: Sharp charcoal suit, immaculate thinning hair, carrying a leather briefcase.

wants: To finalize the property transfer and collect his standard fee.

clocks.name: The Inheritance Tax Deadline
steps: The state issues the preliminary probate evaluation.
Lawyer Arthur Vane requests proof of funds for the estate tax.
A formal warning letter is delivered to the bookstore.
The estate taxes are overdue, triggering foreclosure proceedings.

threads.title: Understanding the Haunting
threads.stakes: Discovering why your grandmother's spirit cannot rest.

threads.title: The Shop's Future
threads.stakes: Finding a way to pay the steep inheritance tax and keep the bookstore.

mysteries.question: Why is my grandmother's ghost lingering in the bookstore?
mysteries.answer: Clara is bound to the physical realm because she died with the secret of a rare folio hidden in the wall, which is needed to pay the bookstore's steep inheritance taxes.
clues: A draft of cool air always points toward a specific hollow mahogany bookshelf.
Clara's old ledgers have a recurring, highlighted bookmark in a book about rare Pacific Northwest history.
The faint scent of lavender drifts near the store's oldest plaster wall whenever the inheritance tax is mentioned.

known_facts: Your grandmother Clara passed away peacefully two weeks ago.
She left you 'The Whispering Pages,' her lifelong bookstore.
Lately, books have been falling off shelves on their own, and you keep hearing faint footsteps upstairs.

positions: You are standing behind the old wooden counter.
Arthur Vane is tapping his pen on a stack of inheritance documents.
props: The heavy brass key to the front door
A warm mug of black coffee
opening.situation: You stand in the dusty air of your late grandmother's bookstore as her lawyer prepares to hand over the keys and the daunting paperwork.

world.summary: Having inherited your late grandmother's historic Seattle bookstore, you find yourself facing steep inheritance taxes and a series of eerie, inexplicable occurrences. It seems your new shop is haunted, and the secrets of the dead might be the only way to save your future.

character.name: Casey Miller
character.description: A weary but resilient Seattle barista with a sharp eye for detail and a fresh grief in their heart.
character.appearance: Messy brown hair, comfortable knit sweater, dark jeans, and sneakers. Usually carrying a faint aroma of roasted coffee beans.

skills.name: Coffee Brewing
skills.notes: Years of early morning shifts have made you a master of the espresso machine.

skills.name: Customer Relations
skills.notes: You know how to defuse tense situations and read people's moods easily.

skills.name: Literary Knowledge
skills.notes: Familiar with classic fiction and local poetry, mostly inherited from conversations with Clara.

traits.name: Observant
traits.description: You notice small shifts in your environment, like a book slightly out of place or a sudden drop in temperature.

traits.name: Grieving
traits.description: The sudden loss of your grandmother weighs heavily on your mind, sometimes distracting you.

powers.name: Spiritual Sensitivity
limits: Only triggers during quiet moments or emotional peaks
Cannot force spirits to speak clearly

wants: Find out if the bookstore is haunted

items.name: Clara's Brass Key
items.description: The heavy, worn brass key that unlocks the front door of The Whispering Pages.

items.name: Smart Phone
items.description: A slightly cracked phone used for messages and checking coffee orders.

goals: Find out if the bookstore is haunted
backstory: You have spent the last five years working grueling shifts at Espresso Oasis to pay your bills.
Your grandmother Clara was your anchor in Seattle, always inviting you upstairs for tea and poetry.
Her sudden passing has left you with her entire legacy—and a lot of questions about what she left behind.
